# Vendor documentation

Third-party material, kept exactly as published. Do not reformat or edit:
these files are the reference the port is checked against, and a local
edit would silently diverge from what the API actually does.

| file | source | captured |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `api-docs.md` | https://api-docs.indstocks.com/ (full export, 21 pages + OpenAPI spec) | 2026-10-29 |

Re-export rather than patch when the API changes, and note the new date here.
